records.sourceMarkdown:
# Enchanting Workshop

*You set your tools beside the impossible ingredient. This is the part of the work that ordinary hands cannot finish.*

## Rules

**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Knowledge

**Time:** The recipe's full stated interval per attempt.

**Target / range / shape:** One known compatible special-item or ordinary recipe.

Choose one special-item recipe available in the campaign and two ordinary recipes chosen from Bound Torches, Fletched Ammunition, Travel Food, Twisted Cord, Wooden Brace and Simple Replacement Leg; learn them. You can craft known special-item recipes and the compatible ordinary recipes using their stated materials, tools and full intervals. Roll Knowledge: Weak adds 1 progress, Standard 2, Strong 3, or the recipe's inventory steps for a supply.

**Equipment / acquisition:** Craft tools (Bulk 1), supplied on learning if needed.

---

**Tier / minimum level:** 7 · **DP:** 8 · **Requirements to learn:** Craft 3

**Type:** Magic / Crafting / Utility

**ID:** enchanting-workshop

# Reckless Charge

*You lower your shoulder and crash forward, blade swinging wide, leaving your guard open.*

## Rules

**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** Brawn

**Target / range / shape:** Self; move up to 2 squares toward an enemy, then make a Basic Melee attack against a creature within reach.

Move up to 2 squares toward an enemy you can see. Then make a Basic Melee attack against a creature within reach. This attack is part of the Maneuver, so your Main Action remains available. On a Weak result, deal 1 extra damage; on a Standard result, deal 2 extra damage; on a Strong result, deal 3 extra damage. Take 1 Bane on defense rolls until the beginning of your next turn. This movement follows normal opportunity attack rules.

**Duration:** The attack resolves immediately. The defense Bane lasts until the beginning of your next turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

---

**Tier / minimum level:** 1 · **DP:** 2 · **Requirements to learn:** Class Blade; minimum level 1

**Type:** Signature

**Tags:** Skill / Attack / Movement

**Limits:** Once on your turn.

**ID:** signature-blade-cut-and-turn

*You get a grip under the arms, lift, and send them somewhere else.*

Make a Brawn roll against the target. On a Weak result, throw it 3 squares. On a Standard result, throw it 5 squares and apply Dazed 1. On a Strong result, throw it 7 squares and apply Dazed 2. Choose the direction. The target lands prone. Resolve collisions normally.

**Duration:** Immediate.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Brawn

**Duration:** Immediate.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

# Relentless Pursuit

*You follow the retreating shoulder through the press, keeping your blade close enough that escape becomes another opening.*

## Rules

**Action:** Reaction · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** A visible enemy within 2 squares when it begins voluntary movement.

After it finishes moving, move up to your Speed toward it without provoking. If you end adjacent, make one free Basic Melee attack against it using Brawn with 1 Boon. On a Weak result, apply Slowed 1. On a Standard result, apply Slowed 2. On a Strong result, apply Slowed 3. Slowed uses normal decay.

**Duration:** Immediate pursuit and attack.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A melee weapon is required for the attack; grants one ordinary melee weapon, Bulk 1, if absent.

*You name the flaw in the guard, then strike through it before the target can close the gap.*

records.name: Out of Body
records.sourceMarkdown:
# Out of Body

*You step out of yourself, leaving your body slumped and prone while your spirit moves free.*

## Rules

**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** None (no roll)

**Target / range / shape:** Self.

Your body falls prone and cannot act, move or take Reactions. It has 3 defense Banes. Your spirit appears in your square or an adjacent free square.

The spirit has Speed 5, can speak, can pass through nonmagical solid objects and creatures, and is immune to mundane attacks. It cannot attack, cast spells, use equipment or physically interact with objects. Its movement does not provoke opportunity attacks. Magical attacks can target it; resolve them against your normal defenses, and damage to the spirit is damage to your body. If your body drops to 0 HP, the projection ends.

At the end of your turn, choose one:

- **Snap Back:** Your spirit returns to your body.
- **Manifest:** Your body appears in the spirit’s square or the nearest free square that is not separated from your body by a solid barrier, prone. The projection ends.

If no legal Manifest square exists, you can only Snap Back.

**Duration:** Until the end of your turn.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

---

**Type:** Signature

**Tags:** Skill / Utility / Movement

# Fast Talk

*You are already three sentences into the lie before the guard decides to be suspicious.*

## Rules

**Action:** Maneuver · **Attribute:** Guile

**Target / range / shape:** One creature within 5 squares that can hear and understand you.

State the social goal you are pursuing and what you want the target to do. Make a Guile roll. The result adds progress toward that goal: Weak: 2 progress. Standard: 3 progress. Strong: 5 progress. The DA sets the progress target before the roll. When the total reaches it, the target agrees within its wants and limits. This does not compel self-harm, betrayal, or a change to its loyalties.

**Duration:** Immediate progress; the negotiation persists.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.

records.name: Triage
records.sourceMarkdown:
# Triage

*Two wounded, one pair of hands, no time to choose wrong.*

## Rules

**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Reason

**Target / range / shape:** One or two living allies within 3 squares.

Moser's law of conservation of Life energy: pay 3 HP before rolling. This cost bypasses resistance and must leave you above 0 HP. Requires a free hand. Make a Reason roll. Choose one or two allies. One ally: restore 6 HP on Weak, 11 HP on Standard, 16 HP on Strong. Two allies: restore 4 HP each on Weak, 7 HP each on Standard, 10 HP each on Strong. Reduce the restored amount by each target's Life resistance, to a minimum of 1 if HP is missing, and never exceed maximum HP. A Dying creature cannot be targeted; stabilize it first. This restores no wounds and cannot reverse Last Words.

**Duration:** Immediate.

**Equipment / acquisition:** A free hand.

---

**Tier / minimum level:** 3 · **DP:** 4 · **Requirements to learn:** Class Shepherd; minimum level 3

**Type:** Signature

**Tags:** Magic / Recovery

**Limits:** Repeatable; normal action economy applies.

**ID:** signature-shepherd-careful-transfer

# Rampage

*You do not stop at the first body.*

**Action:** Main Action · **Attribute:** Brawn

**Target / range / shape:** Self; a straight line up to your Speed.

This ability consumes your Main Action and your movement for the turn. Move up to your Speed in a straight line. Each enemy within 1 square of your path takes 2 physical damage and is pushed 1 square directly away from the path. Then make a Brawn roll against one enemy adjacent to you at the end of the movement. Weak: 3 physical damage. Standard: 4 physical damage, and it is Prone. Strong: 6 physical damage, and it is Prone. If you cannot move at least 2 squares in a straight line, you cannot use this ability. You cannot move again after the charge.

**Duration:** Immediate.

**Equipment / acquisition:** None.
